en: A colorized historic postcard view of a large castle-like building with light stone walls and red-tiled roofs, dominated by a tall round central tower with a dark dome and small spire. Trees and a fenced green area occupy the foreground. The sky is softly tinted in pastel blue and peach. German text is printed at the top identifying the location as Mügeln in the Leipzig district and naming the building Schloss Ruhetal.
